# Audio scenes

An audio scene holds what [buses](Audio-Buses) and the listener should be set to, and sets all of it at once, with a fade, when it is applied. A game makes its scenes while loading and applies one when the place changes, the way it makes entities once and calls RenderWorld every frame. A scene holds only the values that were set in it, so a pause scene that turns the world down leaves the music and the listener alone.

```blitzbasic
Include "<audio.bb>"
world = CreateAudioBus()

; On the planet: air, normal doppler. In space: no doppler, sounds carry less, the world is quieter.
planet = CreateAudioScene()
AudioSceneListener planet, BB_LISTENER_DOPPLER, 1
AudioSceneListener planet, BB_LISTENER_ROLLOFF, 1
AudioSceneVolume planet, world, 1
space = CopyAudioScene(planet)
AudioSceneListener space, BB_LISTENER_DOPPLER, 0
AudioSceneListener space, BB_LISTENER_ROLLOFF, 3
AudioSceneVolume space, world, 0.4

; Leaving the atmosphere takes five seconds.
ApplyAudioScene space, 5000
```

| Command | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| [CreateAudioScene](CreateAudioScene), [FreeAudioScene](FreeAudioScene), [CopyAudioScene](CopyAudioScene) | Make, free and copy a scene. |
| [AudioSceneVolume](AudioSceneVolume) | A bus volume in the scene. |
| [AudioSceneListener](AudioSceneListener) | A listener setting in the scene (`BB_LISTENER_*` from the shipped include file audio.bb). |
| [ClearAudioScene](ClearAudioScene) | Forgets one bus, or everything. |
| [CaptureAudioScene](CaptureAudioScene) | Fills the scene with what everything is at now. |
| [ApplyAudioScene](ApplyAudioScene) | Sets what the scene holds, with a fade. |
| [BlendAudioScene](BlendAudioScene) | Sets a mix of two scenes, for crossfades that follow the player. |

The falloff curve ([ListenerFalloff](ListenerFalloff)) is not in scenes, as a curve can't fade from one to another.
